en: Black‑and‑white view of a large town square with a church tower in the center background. The square is unpaved and mostly empty, with a few pedestrians and small groups of people scattered around, and a horse‑drawn wagon near the church. Surrounding the square are 2–3‑story buildings with steep tiled roofs and dormer windows, typical of Central European small towns. On the ground floors are shops and inns, with German signage visible above the entrances. The church tower has a clock, a balcony below the clock, and a slender spire topped with a cross.
